verses.en: Deliver me from mine enemies, O my God: defend me from them that rise up against me.
verses.pt: Livra-me, Deus meu, dos meus inimigos; protege-me daqueles que se levantam contra mim.
verses.en_web: Deliver me from my enemies, my God. Set me on high from those who rise up against me.
verses.en_bbe: <To the chief music-maker; put to At-tashheth. Michtam. Of David. When Saul sent, and they were watching the house, to put him to death.> Take me out of the hands of the cruel ones, O my God; keep me safe from those who come up against me.

verses.en: Deliver me from the workers of iniquity, and save me from bloody men.
verses.pt: Livra-me do que praticam a iniqüidade, e salva-me dos homens sanguinários.
verses.en_web: Deliver me from the workers of iniquity. Save me from the bloodthirsty men.
verses.en_bbe: Take me out of the power of the workers of evil, and keep me safe from the men of blood.

verses.en: For, lo, they lie in wait for my soul: the mighty are gathered against me; not for my transgression, nor for my sin, O LORD.
verses.pt: Pois eis que armam ciladas à minha alma; os fortes se ajuntam contra mim, não por transgressão minha nem por pecado meu, ó Senhor.
verses.en_web: For, behold, they lie in wait for my soul. The mighty gather themselves together against me, not for my disobedience, nor for my sin, Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: For see, they are watching in secret for my soul; the strong have come together against me? but not because of my sin, or my evil-doing, O Lord.

verses.en: They run and prepare themselves without my fault: awake to help me, and behold.
verses.pt: Eles correm, e se preparam, sem culpa minha; desperta para me ajudares, e olha.
verses.en_web: I have done no wrong, yet they are ready to attack me. Rise up, behold, and help me!
verses.en_bbe: For no sin of mine they go quickly and get themselves ready; be awake and come to my help, and see.

verses.en: Thou therefore, O LORD God of hosts, the God of Israel, awake to visit all the heathen: be not merciful to any wicked transgressors. Selah.
verses.pt: Tu, ó Senhor, Deus dos exércitos, Deus de Israel, desperta para punir todas as nações; não tenhas misericórdia de nenhum dos pérfidos que praticam a iniqüidade.
verses.en_web: You, Yahweh God of Armies, the God of Israel, rouse yourself to punish the nations. Show no mercy to the wicked traitors. Selah.
verses.en_bbe: You, O Lord God of armies, are the God of Israel; come now and give punishment to the nations; have no mercy on any workers of deceit. (Selah.)

verses.en: They return at evening: they make a noise like a dog, and go round about the city.
verses.pt: Eles voltam à tarde, uivam como cães, e andam rodeando a cidade.
verses.en_web: They return at evening, howling like dogs, and prowl around the city.
verses.en_bbe: They come back in the evening; they make a noise like a dog, and go round the town.

verses.en: Behold, they belch out with their mouth: swords are in their lips: for who, say they, doth hear?
verses.pt: Eis que eles soltam gritos; espadas estão nos seus lábios; porque (pensam eles), quem ouve?
verses.en_web: Behold, they spew with their mouth. Swords are in their lips, “For”, they say, “who hears us?”
verses.en_bbe: See, hate is dropping from their lips; curses are on their tongues: they say, Who gives attention to it?

verses.en: But thou, O LORD, shalt laugh at them; thou shalt have all the heathen in derision.
verses.pt: Mas tu, Senhor, te rirás deles; zombarás de todas as nações.
verses.en_web: But you, Yahweh, laugh at them. You scoff at all the nations.
verses.en_bbe: But you are laughing at them, O Lord; you will make sport of all the nations.

verses.en: Because of his strength will I wait upon thee: for God is my defence.
verses.pt: Em ti, força minha, esperarei; pois Deus é o meu alto refúgio.
verses.en_web: Oh, my Strength, I watch for you, for God is my high tower.
verses.en_bbe: O my strength, I will put my hope in you; because God is my strong tower.

verses.en: The God of my mercy shall prevent me: God shall let me see my desire upon mine enemies.
verses.pt: O meu Deus com a sua benignidade virá ao meu encontro; Deus me fará ver o meu desejo sobre os meus inimigos.
verses.en_web: My God will go before me with his loving kindness. God will let me look at my enemies in triumph.
verses.en_bbe: The God of my mercy will go before me: God will let me see my desire effected on my haters.

verses.en: Slay them not, lest my people forget: scatter them by thy power; and bring them down, O Lord our shield.
verses.pt: Não os mates, para que meu povo não se esqueça; espalha-os pelo teu poder, e abate-os ó Senhor, escudo nosso.
verses.en_web: Don’t kill them, or my people may forget. Scatter them by your power, and bring them down, Lord our shield.
verses.en_bbe: Put them not to death, for so my people will keep the memory of them: let them be sent in all directions by your power; make them low, O Lord our saviour.

verses.en: For the sin of their mouth and the words of their lips let them even be taken in their pride: and for cursing and lying which they speak.
verses.pt: Pelo pecado da sua boca e pelas palavras dos seus lábios fiquem presos na sua soberba. Pelas maldições e pelas mentiras que proferem,
verses.en_web: For the sin of their mouth, and the words of their lips, let them be caught in their pride, for the curses and lies which they utter.
verses.en_bbe: Because of the sin of their mouths and the word of their lips, let them even be taken in their pride; and for their curses and their deceit,

verses.en: Consume them in wrath, consume them, that they may not be: and let them know that God ruleth in Jacob unto the ends of the earth. Selah.
verses.pt: consome-os na tua indignação; consome-os, de modo que não existem mais; para que saibam que Deus reina sobre Jacó, até os confins da terra.
verses.en_web: Consume them in wrath. Consume them, and they will be no more. Let them know that God rules in Jacob, to the ends of the earth. Selah.
verses.en_bbe: Put an end to them in your wrath, put an end to them, so that they may not be seen again; let them see that God is ruling in Jacob and to the ends of the earth. (Selah.)

verses.en: And at evening let them return; and let them make a noise like a dog, and go round about the city.
verses.pt: Eles tornam a vir à tarde, uivam como cães, e andam rodeando a cidade;
verses.en_web: At evening let them return. Let them howl like a dog, and go around the city.
verses.en_bbe: And in the evening let them come back, and make a noise like a dog, and go round the town.

verses.en: Let them wander up and down for meat, and grudge if they be not satisfied.
verses.pt: vagueiam buscando o que comer, e resmungam se não se fartarem.
verses.en_web: They shall wander up and down for food, and wait all night if they aren’t satisfied.
verses.en_bbe: Let them go wandering up and down in search of food, and be there all night if they have not enough.

verses.en: But I will sing of thy power; yea, I will sing aloud of thy mercy in the morning: for thou hast been my defence and refuge in the day of my trouble.
verses.pt: Eu, porém, cantarei a tua força; pela manhã louvarei com alegria a tua benignidade, porquanto tens sido para mim uma fortaleza, e refúgio no dia da minha angústia.
verses.en_web: But I will sing of your strength. Yes, I will sing aloud of your loving kindness in the morning. For you have been my high tower, a refuge in the day of my distress.
verses.en_bbe: But I will make songs of your power; yes, I will give cries of joy for your mercy in the morning; because you have been my strength and my high tower in the day of my trouble.

verses.en: Unto thee, O my strength, will I sing: for God is my defence, and the God of my mercy.
verses.pt: A ti, ó força minha, cantarei louvores; porque Deus é a minha fortaleza, é o Deus que me mostra benignidade.
verses.en_web: To you, my strength, I will sing praises. For God is my high tower, the God of my mercy.
verses.en_bbe: To you, O my strength, will I make my song: because God is my high tower, even the God of my mercy.
